prompts.seagull:
Asset type: production website character PNG, transparent background. Original Korean Busan career simulator mascot. Single full-body standing character centered, entire body and feet visible, ample transparent margin. Consistent design system: polished flat 2D editorial mascot, soft rounded proportions, sturdy clean deep navy outlines, restrained light-blue and cobalt accents, small warm peach cheeks, simple black oval eyes with white highlights, tiny friendly smile, subtle cel shading, white shirt and cobalt tie with a rectangular light-blue intern lanyard badge (no text). Two short legs and dark navy shoes. Three-quarter front view facing slightly left. Professional but approachable young adult intern, not toddler art. Clear silhouette, not 3D, no gradients in the character, no background, no ground shadow, no letters, no logo, no watermark. Do not imitate any existing municipal mascot or brand.
Subject: a cheerful white SEAGULL job applicant with a round white head, short orange beak, light gray wing tips. One wing holds a tidy light-blue résumé folder with blank white pages visible; other wing lifted in a small confident greeting. Cobalt blue tie over simple white collar, tiny rectangular badge, navy shoes, orange slim legs. Slight oval body, no hat.

Subject: an anthropomorphic BUSAN DWAEJI-GUKBAP (Korean pork soup) bowl intern. The body IS a round dark navy earthenware soup bowl, pale creamy milky pork broth clearly visible from an angled top view with several unmistakable pink-beige sliced pork pieces, pale cooked rice at one side, a few green chopped scallions and a tiny red sauce dollop. Two white curling steam wisps above, like a little tuft. Friendly eyes and smile on bowl front; peach cheeks. Two tiny arms, one holding a clipboard with blank paper and one holding a slim spoon. Blue intern lanyard ID hanging on bowl front. Two short cobalt-trouser legs and navy shoes. Little white shirt cuffs at the arms. Pork soup must be clearly recognizable, not an empty rice bowl or ramen.

Subject: a completely ORIGINAL cute dark navy-black DUSKY SHARK intern inspired by the natural sharks of Busan North Port. Broad rounded shark snout, small dorsal fin behind head, side fins, distinct shark tail peeking on right, light slate-blue belly. Upright full body on two short legs. Cobalt tie and small white collar, blank sky-blue lanyard badge. One fin grips a compact light-blue briefcase, the other on hip confidently. Friendly smile with only two tiny soft triangular teeth. No hat, no scars. Not any official Bukangi or existing shark mascot.
